meta.name: think
meta.description: Sequential thinking — decompose a problem into structured thoughts before acting. `agon think "..." --strategy reflexion`. Opt-in; surfaces open questions and a goal handoff.

problem.description: The task / problem to think through.

strategy.description: Thinking method: linear | reflexion (forced critique+revision) | tot (self-scored branches, prune to winner) | graph (branch then merge) | hypothesis (competing hypotheses, eliminate losers).

critic.description: A SECOND engine that adversarially attacks the chain after it is produced (cross-engine critique). e.g. --critic codex.

engine.description: Engine id to think with. Omit to use the default (first active) engine.

steps.description: Max thoughts (steps of thought) to produce. Clamped to 1..20.

branches.description: Explore N alternative reasoning branches (emission only — v1 does not auto-score/prune). Clamped to 1..8. e.g. --steps 20 --branches 5.

ground.description: Verify file paths cited in thoughts against the repo and flag phantom ones. On by default; --no-ground to disable.

goal.description: Print a ready-to-run `agon goal` handoff built from the refined spec.

json.description: Emit the full ThinkResult as JSON on stdout (the handoff artifact; pipe-friendly).

label.description: Human-readable suffix baked into the run dir name.
